headline: BlockLock paper reports reproducible batched LLM inference with fixed request geometry
summary: A 4 November 2026 preprint introduces BlockLock, which fixes the execution geometry of one protected request while retaining shared batched prefill for companion requests. The authors report bitwise-identical target outputs across companion changes under a fixed deployment contract. Across five dense models and NVIDIA A6000, A100 and H100 deployments, they report 53.5–55.0% lower latency and 115.2–122.2% higher throughput than vLLM Batch-Invariant at batch size 4 and 64 output tokens; reported overhead is 5.4–6.9% versus standard vLLM and 0.5–0.8% versus padded PyTorch. These are author-reported, configuration-specific results; no independent reproduction, MoE evaluation or queueing/tail-latency study is established.
